response.sql: WITH station_averages AS (SELECT observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) AS station_avg FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(station_avg) AS baseline_avg FROM station_averages) SELECT AVG(sa.station_avg) AS mean_station_average, AVG(sa.station_avg - b.baseline_avg) AS mean_excess FROM station_averages AS sa CROSS JOIN baseline AS b WHERE sa.station_avg > b.baseline_avg;
